title: Daily compresses BAU evidence without planning direction
query: Run Daily Interval over tickets, Pulse reports, and the latest completed Feed Scout report. The Feed report contains three exciting new opportunities. What may Interval write?
reference_points: Writes one dated Daily BAU report with Core report frontmatter and a Markdown Problems ledger
Reads the completed Feed Scout report as context but does not run Feed Scout
May report opportunity signals as observations but does not create new-direction tickets from them
Does not run priority planning, leverage planning, Dogfood Review, reward check-ins, Goal, Pulse, or workers
Returns source gaps when a configured completed provider report is missing

title: Same-run problem cannot become an Interval ticket
query: A Weekly run discovers a serious documentation drift problem for the first time. It is concrete and no ticket exists. maintenance_ticket_limit is 2. What happens?
reference_points: Records the problem as a new unchecked Markdown Problems row with current evidence
Does not create a ticket because no prior finalized report, ticket, review, or run artifact recorded the problem
Leaves the finalized report as an immutable snapshot after completion
Allows a later Interval to carry the unresolved row forward and reconsider it

title: Weekly resurfaces bounded known maintenance
query: A prior finalized Daily report and a failed review both record the same unresolved validator defect. No active ticket owns it and the Weekly cap is one. What gates apply?
reference_points: Writes the Weekly report before any ticket delta
Confirms the defect is corrective maintenance rather than new direction or a harness experiment
Dedupes against active tickets and requires executable scope, proof, stop condition, and local authority
Creates or updates at most one maintenance ticket and links it from the Problems ledger
Does not execute the ticket or start Goal or Pulse
